newsitem.title: POLAND: Large paedophile ring exposed in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Large paedophile ring exposed in Poland.

text.p: Polish television on Tuesday exposed Poland's biggest ever child sex scandal, involving a local government official who allegedly organised a club for homosexual paedophiles.
Public television's main evening news programme Wiadomosci said police and prosecutors in the northern port of Szczecin had confirmed its findings and launched a large-scale investigation.
"There is a lot of work ahead of us because interrogating more than 1,000 people is involved," Szczecin police commissioner Pawel Wiedziak told the television.

The television said the sex club was organised by 40-year-old local government official and former army officer, identified only by his nickname "Major," who was arrested on charges including sex with children.
Police found pornographic films and photographs showing sex with boys under the age of 15 in "Major's" apartment. The television showed blurred photographs found in the apartment showing sexual acts.
It said the man's computer contained a list of more than 1,000 names of victims and clients.
The television quoted police as saying the case might be the tip of an iceberg and that it had evidence the scandal was international, without elaborating.
It interviewed several boys, who said they were sexually abused by the man and others.
"We drank, then we bought another one... and then he told us to undress and so we undressed," an unidentified boy told the programme.
The report said the man recruited victims, mostly pupils of local primary schools, at railway stations and video stores.
